Fairly detailed set of photos and a video to help me get it set up for my copy of this game.   Only one set of pieces didn't seem to have a place.  As there is ample additional space available, this isn't that much of a problem...  it just seems odd.    UPDATE:  I sent a help request and Caren responded promptly with a picture identifying the location.    Turned out that I had missed seeing that location being empty, so I was easily able to place the pieces in their proper location.

This insert works perfectly! The little dots above the “I” came off, but they were super small. I have 110 micron card sleeves & there’s still extra room for the Pulse expansion.

My only other note is on the seller. She's super nice, and helped me with adding an extra item to my cart. Downside, her response time is extremely slow, and shipping was late too. I ordered everything on 6/21 and the estimated delivery time was to be between 7/15 - 8/2. Followed up on 7/17 about progress, received response on 7/20 that it would be a few more days to pack & ship.

Followed up again on 8/4 and received a response later that evening that it was shipping on 8/5. I received my package on 8/10. Some proactive transparency on progress, from the seller, would've been nice.
